content.short: WingRiders self-servicing automated smart contract launchpad offers users a chance to participate in new projects.
content.description: WingRiders self-servicing automated smart contract launchpad offers users a chance to participate in new projects by supporting their Cardano Native Tokens in the early stages to develop their projects and enter the market. WingRiders Launchpad is: Non-custodial: No one else has access or control over your and project tokens in any phase of a Launch. Smart-contract-based fully automated: Powered by seven Plutarch Smart Contracts and six minting policies on Cardano.
